tasks.completion_summary: Added ownership gate to startupOrphanPGIDScan that refuses to reap orphan pgids unless an ancestor chain resolves to an agnt-like cmdline AND a cwd inside a known project path; fixes cross-daemon session kills.

Audit menu popover: added CSS anchor positioning progressive enhancement (anchor-name + position-anchor + position-try-fallbacks) gated on CSS.supports, fixed upper-left-corner bug on JS fallback via double rAF, and cleared inline inset-longhand shorthand expansion so stylesheet anchor() rules win over inline cascade.
